tasks.label: Build Project (javac)
args: if not exist bin mkdir bin && "C:\Program Files\Java\jdk1.8.0_202\bin\javac.exe" -encoding UTF-8 -d bin -sourcepath src src/Main.java

tasks.label: Run FoodDelivery (Console)
args: if not exist bin mkdir bin && "C:\Program Files\Java\jdk1.8.0_202\bin\javac.exe" -encoding UTF-8 -d bin -sourcepath src src/Main.java && chcp 65001 >nul && "C:\Program Files\Java\jdk1.8.0_202\bin\java.exe" -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -cp bin Main

tasks.label: Run SystemVerificationTest
args: if not exist bin mkdir bin && "C:\Program Files\Java\jdk1.8.0_202\bin\javac.exe" -encoding UTF-8 -d bin -sourcepath src src/util/SystemVerificationTest.java && chcp 65001 >nul && "C:\Program Files\Java\jdk1.8.0_202\bin\java.exe" -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 -cp bin util.SystemVerificationTest
